blocks.text: MINNEAPOLIS– Jaden McDaniels hit a go-ahead layup with 2.6 seconds remaining after Minnesota stole a Portland inbounds pass and the Timberwolves rallied to beat the Trail Blazers 106-105 in the NBA on Tuesday night. Portland led for nearly the entire fourth quarter before the Wolves mounted a furious comeback. Ayo Dosunmu hit a clutch 3-pointer with 50 seconds remaining to cut the lead to 105-104, setting up McDaniels’ big shot. Portland’s Damian Lillard had a look at a game-winning shot, but Minnesota’s Trey Lyles blocked it with a second remaining.
